summary: A campaign office’s liability insurance depends on different volunteers covering different months.
realLife: At its Mercado Mall office opening, the Mojave Desert club recorded separate volunteers’ commitments for each month of liability coverage during the lease (June 25, 2016).
inGame: needs: the lease term, premium schedule, named pledges and payment receipts.

turns.what: The treasurer pays the premium and records the contribution.
turns.pulledBy: The member assigned this month sends the promised amount.
turns.writesBack: The next month remains assigned to its original volunteer.

turns.what: The treasurer asks whether the committee can cover the gap.
turns.pulledBy: The premium comes due before the pledged money arrives.
turns.writesBack: The ledger distinguishes the unpaid pledge from the premium.
